note_en: Observations from building the dataset. These are descriptive measurements, not quality judgments; every item links to the raw data that produced it. Single prompt family, small N — read as signals, not conclusions.
note_zh: 构建数据集过程中的观察。全部是描述性测量,不是质量评判;每条都指向产生它的原始数据。单一提示族、小 N——当信号看,别当结论。

findings.title_zh: Claude 2025 年的写法,比 Claude 自己活得久
findings.body_en: Claude Sonnet 4 / 4.5, Opus 4.5 and Haiku 4.5 form one tight code-habit cluster with MiniMax M2.1–M2.7, Doubao Seed 2.1 Pro, Grok 4.3, DeepSeek V3.2, Qwen3-Coder-Next and Gemini 3 Flash / 3.1 Pro: cross-lab pairs score in the 87th–100th percentile on both prompts (MiniMax at the 98th), as close as two configs of one model, across harnesses, efforts and all ten code channels. Claude itself moved on — Claude 4.5 against Claude Opus 4.8 / Claude 5 sits at the 14th–22nd percentile, farther apart than two unrelated labs. One telltale line, “const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];”, is in 63% of Claude Sonnet 4/4.5 cards, 34% of the other members' cards, and none of 571 Claude Opus 4.8+ cards. GPT models of the same period never joined the cluster.
findings.body_zh: Claude Sonnet 4 / 4.5、Opus 4.5、Haiku 4.5 和 MiniMax M2.1–M2.7、豆包 Seed 2.1 Pro、Grok 4.3、DeepSeek V3.2、Qwen3-Coder-Next、Gemini 3 Flash / 3.1 Pro 组成一个紧密的代码习惯簇:跨厂商的配对在两个 prompt 上落在第 87–100 百分位(MiniMax 在第 98),和同一模型的两个 config 一样近,跨 harness、跨 effort、十个代码通道全部一致。Claude 自己却走开了——Claude 4.5 对 Claude Opus 4.8 / Claude 5 只有第 14–22 百分位,比两个不相干的厂商还远。一行标志性代码 「const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];」 出现在 63% 的 Claude Sonnet 4/4.5 卡、34% 的其他成员卡里,而 571 张 Claude Opus 4.8+ 卡一张都没有。同时期的 GPT 从未进入这个簇。
findings.caveat_en: Code-habit fingerprint (v16), percentile among cross pairs of this 585-config set; holds under every scoring variant tested. Describes how the code is written, not where a model came from.
findings.caveat_zh: 代码习惯指纹(v16),在本 585 个 config 的跨配对中的百分位;在测试过的各种评分方案下都成立。描述的是代码怎么写,不是模型从哪来。

findings.title_zh: 高 effort 写得更“防御”
findings.body_en: Counted directly in the cards: “prefers-reduced-motion” handling and aborting stale requests with “AbortController” appear in 55–69% of high-effort (xhigh and above) Claude Opus 5.x and GPT Sol cards, and in 0–2% of low-effort GPT Sol cards. DeepSeek V4.1 1017 writes them in 25–33% of its API cards and in 88% of the cards from DeepSeek's own dsh harness. On the whole-code fingerprint this does not make those models alike: it is three idioms, not a shared style.
findings.body_zh: 直接数卡片里的代码:“prefers-reduced-motion”处理、用“AbortController”中止过期请求,出现在 55–69% 的高 effort(xhigh 及以上)Claude Opus 5.x 和 GPT Sol 卡里,低 effort 的 GPT Sol 卡只有 0–2%。DeepSeek V4.1 1017 的 API 卡有 25–33% 这样写,DeepSeek 自家 dsh harness 出的卡是 88%。在整份代码的指纹上,这并不让这些模型变得相像:这是三种写法,不是共同的风格。

figures.label_zh: 高 effort Opus 5.x / Sol 卡

findings.caveat_en: Replaces an earlier card (“At high effort, Claude and GPT start writing alike — and DeepSeek V4.1 already writes that way”) that rested on the v15 fingerprint, which pulled configs that resemble nobody towards each other. With card size handled directly (v16) neither half holds; see the methodology page.
findings.caveat_zh: 取代旧的一条(“高 effort 下 Claude 和 GPT 开始写得一样——而 DeepSeek V4.1 本来就这么写”)。那一条建立在 v15 指纹上,v15 会把和谁都不像的 config 拉到一起;直接处理卡片体积(v16)之后,两半都不成立。见方法论页。

findings.title_en: Some labs change hands between generations
findings.title_zh: 有的厂商换代就换了一手写法
findings.body_en: DeepSeek V4.1 against every earlier DeepSeek scores at the 46th–54th percentile — an unrelated pair — while its two V4.1 builds (0910, 1017) agree at the 73rd–75th. Kimi K3 against Kimi K2.x: 53rd–62nd; K3 sits closer to Claude Fable 5 / Opus 4.8 (82nd–89th). GPT-6 against GPT-5.x stays at the 73rd–75th, an ordinary same-family level.
findings.body_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 对所有更早的 DeepSeek 只有第 46–54 百分位——相当于不相干的一对——而它自己的两个构建(0910、1017)之间是第 73–75。Kimi K3 对 Kimi K2.x:第 53–62;K3 反而更靠近 Claude Fable 5 / Opus 4.8(第 82–89)。GPT-6 对 GPT-5.x 是第 73–75,普通的同家族水平。
findings.caveat_en: Code-habit fingerprint (v16); holds under every scoring variant tested. Same-family-different-model pairs sit around the 70th percentile for reference.
findings.caveat_zh: 代码习惯指纹(v16);在测试过的各种评分方案下都成立。同家族不同模型配对大约在第 70 百分位,可作参照。

findings.title_en: The harness changes how much a model draws — not how it writes
findings.title_zh: harness 改变模型画多少,不改变它怎么写
findings.body_en: Through a different harness the same model at the same effort keeps its code habits: on the code fingerprint, cross-harness pairs sit at the 99th percentile, the same as the model's own re-runs, and two different-family models gain only 6–7 percentile points from sharing a harness. What the harness does move is, above all, the volume of what gets drawn.
findings.body_zh: 同一模型、同一 effort 换一个 harness,代码习惯不变:在代码指纹上,跨 harness 配对落在第 99 百分位,和模型自己重跑一样;两个不同家族的模型共用一个 harness 也只多 6–7 个百分点。harness 真正改变的,主要是画出来的体量。
findings.caveat_en: Replaces an earlier version of this card (cross-arm 0.60–0.69 on the old raw channel average, measured on the gpt family only), which mistook the old scale's spread for a harness effect.
findings.caveat_zh: 取代本卡的旧版(旧的原始通道平均下跨臂 0.60–0.69,只在 gpt 家族测得),那一版把旧尺度的离散误读成了 harness 效应。

findings.title_en: Effort multiplies output size — up to 14x on fable-5
findings.title_zh: effort 放大输出体量——fable-5 最高 14 倍
findings.body_en: Through the Claude Code harness, raising effort from low to max grows the generated card by roughly 14x (fable-5), 12x (opus-4.8) and 9x (sonnet-5) in output volume. The knob visibly changes how much gets drawn.
findings.body_zh: 经 Claude Code harness,effort 从 low 拉到 max,产出卡片体量约放大 14 倍(fable-5)、12 倍(opus-4.8)、9 倍(sonnet-5)。这个旋钮真实改变了画多少东西。
findings.caveat_en: Output volume, not quality; single prompt family.
findings.caveat_zh: 是输出体量不是质量;单一提示族。

findings.title_en: On some models the effort knob does nothing measurable
findings.title_zh: 有些模型的 effort 旋钮拧了没反应
findings.body_en: haiku-4.5 (Claude Code harness) and grok-4.5 (official api) produce statistically indistinguishable output volume across every effort tier we ran. grok-4.3 on the same official api does respond to the knob.
findings.body_zh: haiku-4.5(Claude Code harness)和 grok-4.5(官方 api)在我们跑过的所有 effort 档位上输出体量无可辨差异。同一官方 api 上的 grok-4.3 对旋钮有响应。

findings.title_en: GPT's "max" effort arrived with gpt-5.6 — older models just don't have it
findings.title_zh: GPT 的 "max" 档从 gpt-5.6 起才有——只是旧模型没有
findings.body_en: On the official api, effort=max is rejected (400) by every gpt model before gpt-5.6 and accepted by gpt-5.6-sol / terra / luna. The newer gpt-6 / 6.1 models take it too (run here through Codex). The effort ladder grows with the generation; it is not one family's exclusive.
findings.body_zh: 官方 api 上,gpt-5.6 之前的 gpt 模型对 effort=max 一律 400,gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna 接受。更新的 gpt-6 / 6.1 也有 max(本集经 Codex 跑)。effort 梯子随代际变长,不是某一系独占。

figures.label_zh: 最早有 max 的 gpt

findings.caveat_en: Official-api acceptance probed by behavior on 2026-07-18; gpt-6 / 6.1 max observed through the Codex harness.
findings.caveat_zh: 官方 api 的接受情况为 2026-07-18 行为探测所得;gpt-6 / 6.1 的 max 是经 Codex harness 观察到的。

findings.title_en: Official api outputs run 5-8x larger than the same model via a proxy channel
findings.title_zh: 官方 api 输出比同模型代理通道大 5-8 倍
findings.body_en: For the same gpt model and effort, the official api produced 5-8x more card HTML than the reverse-proxy dev channel. Channel identity materially changes what you get — one reason this dataset separates channel grades.
findings.body_zh: 同一 gpt 模型同一 effort,官方 api 产出的卡片 HTML 是反代 dev 通道的 5-8 倍。通道本身实质性改变产出——这是本数据集区分通道等级的原因之一。
findings.caveat_en: Dev-channel data is not published; the comparison informed our channel-grade policy.
findings.caveat_zh: dev 通道数据不发布;该对比塑造了通道分级政策。

findings.title_en: Working inside an agentic harness is its own capability axis
findings.title_zh: 在 agentic harness 里干活是一条独立的能力轴
findings.body_en: Several previous-generation models that answer fine over the plain api fail outright (server 500) when driven through the opencode agentic harness on the same subscription channel. Tool-loop operation is not implied by api competence.
findings.body_zh: 多个上一代模型 api 直连正常作答,但在同一订阅通道的 opencode agentic harness 里直接 500。会答 api 不等于会在工具循环里干活。
findings.caveat_en: Gateway-side effect cannot be fully excluded.
findings.caveat_zh: 无法完全排除网关侧因素。

findings.title_en: kimi-k3 spends ~10x thinking on the qualitative prompt variant
findings.title_zh: kimi-k3 在质性提示变体上思考量 ~10 倍
findings.body_en: On the P-q (qualitative) prompt variant, kimi-k3's reasoning volume ran about 10x its P-min behavior — the largest variant sensitivity we observed.
findings.body_zh: 在 P-q(质性)提示变体上,kimi-k3 的思考量约为 P-min 的 10 倍——我们观察到的最大变体敏感度。
findings.caveat_en: Single model observation on a dev-grade channel; to be re-verified on a qualified channel.
findings.caveat_zh: 单模型、dev 级通道上的观察;待合格通道复核。
